## Academic Experience {#academic-experience}
:::

::: {.cv-item}
[Apr 2026 – present]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
### [Kansas State University](https://www.k-state.edu/)

::: {.cv-roles}
[[**Postdoctoral Fellow** · Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering]{.cv-r}]{.cv-role}
[[**Instructor** · ECE 685 Power Systems Design]{.cv-r}[Fall 2026]{.cv-when}]{.cv-role}
:::

- Leading techno-economic and optimization research on small modular reactor (SMR)-powered data centers, quantifying colocation economics, delayed grid energization, and alternative grid-coupling architectures under load and market uncertainty.
- Developing system-level evaluation metrics and a multi-account cost framework spanning private, ratepayer, and social perspectives, extending prior nuclear–hydrogen–battery and carbon-aware scheduling work to AI-driven electricity demand growth.
:::
:::

::: {.cv-item}
[Sep 2025 – Apr 2026]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
### [University of Texas at Dallas](https://personal.utdallas.edu/~jiezhang/group.html)

::: {.cv-roles}
[[**Research Associate**]{.cv-r}]{.cv-role}
:::

- Led a techno-economic study of a BWRX-300 small modular reactor whose turbine-extracted steam drives absorption chillers, supplying a data center with both power and cooling; steam, cooling, and power were co-optimized hourly with ERCOT prices (first author; accepted in Energy Conversion and Management).
- Mapped where SMR supply becomes competitive with grid supply, and how an output-based production credit shifts steam from cooling to generation.
:::
:::
:::

## Internships {#internships}
:::

::: {.cv-item}
[Feb 2025 – Aug 2025]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
### [Idaho National Laboratory (INL)](https://inl.gov/)

- **Optimization of Hydrogen Integration in Nuclear Grid Services:** Developed an **optimization framework** using mathematical programming techniques to identify the most profitable deployment strategies for nuclear-powered hydrogen production. Integrated techno-economic analysis, historical market data (ISO prices), and policy incentives (45V tax credits) to maximize revenue from hydrogen sales and grid ancillary services; results published in *Nature Communications* (2026, first author).
- **Techno-Economic Analysis of Non-Powered Dam Retrofits:** Contributed a pro-forma techno-economic module to an INL toolset for retrofitting U.S. non-powered dams with hydropower and battery storage; integration with floating PV was scoped in planning.
:::
:::

::: {.cv-item}
[Aug 2024 – Jan 2025]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
### [FM](https://www.fm.com/)

- **Solar PV Microgrid Design Optimization:** Developed and implemented a techno-economic model incorporating **optimization techniques** to determine the optimal sizing of solar PV, battery storage, and backup generation for an industrial research campus microgrid. Minimized levelized cost of energy subject to meeting demand in modeled grid-outage scenarios, using a DOE reference load profile scaled to the campus's annual consumption and site solar resource data.
- **Lithium Battery Production Line Simulation and Bottleneck Optimization:** Built a discrete-event simulation model (Arena) of a lithium battery production line to quantify the economic impact of equipment failures and maintenance schedules. Identified production bottlenecks and analyzed potential improvements through simulation, implicitly informing optimization of maintenance and buffer strategies.
- **Wind Farm Maintenance Strategy Optimization:** Proposed a research framework featuring an **optimization model** to determine the optimal predictive and corrective maintenance scheduling for wind farms. Aimed at balancing O&M costs, maximizing energy production (reducing downtime), and ensuring long-term asset reliability.
:::
:::
:::

## Skills {#skills}
:::

::: {.cv-skills}
Optimization Techniques
:   Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), Non-Linear Programming (NLP), Stochastic Programming, Dynamic Programming, Constraint Programming Basics.

Optimization Software
:   Solvers: **Gurobi**, **CPLEX**, **SCIP**; Modeling Languages: **AMPL**, **Pyomo** (Python), **JuMP** (Julia), **GAMS**.

Programming & Data Analysis
:   **Python** (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, Pyomo), **SQL**, **MATLAB**, **R**, **Julia**.

Simulation
:   Discrete-Event Simulation (**Arena**), Monte Carlo Methods, System Dynamics Modeling.

Techno-Economic Analysis (TEA)
:   LCOE/LCOH, NPV, IRR, Cash Flow Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis (applied for optimization model inputs & validation).

Life-Cycle Assessment (LCA)
:   Carbon Footprint Accounting, Integration with TEA.

Machine Learning for OR
:   Surrogate Modeling (Gaussian Processes), Uncertainty Quantification, Time Series Forecasting (LSTM).

Domain Knowledge
:   Renewable Energy Systems (Wind, Solar PV), Data Centers, Energy Storage (Battery, Hydrogen), Power Grid Operations & Ancillary Services, Electricity Markets (ERCOT, MISO basics), Carbon Neutrality Strategies, Manufacturing Systems.
:::
:::
